title: The Sundarbans
info: The Sundarbans is the largest mangrove forest in the world.
It spreads across the coast of Bangladesh and India.
Mangroves grow in salty, tidal water. The forest is a famous home of the Bengal tiger and a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
